snippet.title: Sophia Academic Review Desk: Academic review support without ghostwriting or replacing authorship.
snippet.description:
Sophia Academic Review Desk is part of the KnowEdge AutoRelease Suite.

Buyer: Postgraduate students, supervisors, writing centres, and research groups
Pain: Students need high-level feedback on argument, sources, referencing, and structure without crossing integrity lines.
Promise: Argument review, source-fit checks, referencing feedback, revision priorities, and supervisor-friendly summaries.

CTA: Submit one section for source-fit and argument review.

This is a review-first workflow. Human approval remains required.
